newsitem.title: USA: Integrated Health finishes note tender.
newsitem.headline: Integrated Health finishes note tender.

text.p: Integrated Health Services Inc said Friday it accepted 99 percent each of its 9-5/8 percent senior subordinated notes due 2002 and 10-3/4 percent senior subordinated notes due 2004 under its cash tender offer.
The company said the tenders represent an aggregate of $115.0 million principal amount of the 9-5/8 percent notes and $99.9 million principal amount of the 10-3/4 percent notes.
About $25,000 principal amount of the 9-5/8 notes remain outstanding, and about $107,000 of the 10-3/4 notes remain outstanding, the company said.
